name: John Deere Ottumwa Works - Ottumwa IA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance off the south access road from E Vine St; satellite z21 shows a gatehouse structure sitting in the drive with an apron in front and a perimeter fence line running off both sides.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small standalone gatehouse booth at the entrance (~1-2 vehicle footprint). Corroborated by driver reviews referencing 'friendly staff from the gate house to the docks' and on-site security.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed gate house is present.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Large paved employee lot / open apron outside the gate provides ample truck staging room before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Extensive paved internal yards and open lots between the gate and the scattered dock faces.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the gate to the building docks; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and abundant unused paved width at the gate; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Legacy assembly-plant docks scattered across multiple connected building faces rather than one rhythmic bank; estimated 25-50 total, low-confidence count from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large open trailer/material storage lots on the SE and N sides hold rows of parked trailers without tractors; 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Shipping and receiving docks observed on physically separate building faces (south-central building vs. east/north faces).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial site in small-city Ottumwa, IA, bordered by farmland and the Des Moines River; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sprawling campus of ~8 distinct connected/adjacent manufacturing buildings.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots on-site, distinct from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed running into the property in current imagery.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Exit lane count not separately determinable; entry/exit share the single gate.
